prompt: For each store, what was the net revenue in January, February and March 2025, side by side? Use the sales table and its order_month column, the first day of the month an order was placed in. Count only order lines with an order_date from 2025-01-01 to 2025-03-31, both days included; the webshop, WEB-01, counts as a store. Return four columns, in this order: store_code, jan_revenue_eur, feb_revenue_eur and mar_revenue_eur, the sum of net_revenue_eur in each of those months. Lines with a missing net_revenue_eur add nothing, and a month in which a store has no net revenue shows 0, not a missing value. Return one row per store_code that has at least one order line in those three months. Do not round. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, write the three monthly revenue columns, one per month.
Each month is a SUM with a CASE that passes on net_revenue_eur when order_month is that month's first day and 0 otherwise. ELSE 0 keeps a quiet month at 0, and the store alone decides the grouping.
why_this_works: Grouping by store gives one row per store, and one CASE per month moves each month's revenue into its own column, with ELSE 0 so a month without sales shows 0 instead of a missing value.
